title: UNBELIEVABLE. he rehearsed this!
old_caption: "I've changed" is lovely to hear, and words are a start. Change you can trust shows up in actions, over time. You're allowed to wait and see it.

title: Who almost texted their ex? Everyone.
old_caption:
That almost-text to your ex? Everyone in the booths has one, Venus included. She called a friend instead.
The urge is normal. Reaching out to someone who supports you is the kinder choice.

title: Venus vs. Mars. All rise.
old_caption: Missing someone is real, and it's okay to feel it. But missing isn't a reason to go back. Old love isn't evidence for what you need now.

title: Inanna's Descent
old_caption:
In the old Sumerian myth, Inanna passes seven gates and leaves something behind at each one. Venus follows along with seven keepsakes from her exes.
What you set down after a breakup can help you rise lighter.

title: BREAKING: Venus is going forward.
old_caption:
After weeks of looking back, Venus is officially moving forward. The exes drift off, the watching stops, and good news arrives.
There's real relief in choosing to move on. Forward looks good on you.

title: Today: 90% chance of nostalgia.
old_caption: Old photos can glow pink in memory. When you zoom in, the moment often looked different. It's okay to feel nostalgic. Just remember nostalgia is a filter, not the full picture.

title: Who wants to text an ex?
old_caption: Thumb hovering over a draft to your ex? Every lifeline here gives the same answer. If you're tempted tonight, put the phone face down. You can choose yourself instead.

title: unfollow
old_caption:
A whole crew, a countdown and a careful plan just to unfollow an ex quietly. Then Virgo simply taps the button.
You don't need a grand plan to protect your peace. Unfollowing is allowed.

title: Pisces is singing the song.
old_caption:
Pisces starts the breakup ballad, and Virgo gently edits the lyrics mid-song: from "come back to me" to "be well, truly."
Feel every note, then sing it to the room instead of sending it to their phone.

title: Libra’s ex is at the door.
old_caption: When an ex keeps coming back, opening the door can feel polite. You don't owe anyone that. A calm, kind "I'm good" is enough. Back isn't better.
